concepts.title: Risk Pattern Specification
concepts.authored_definition: A managed, reusable information specification of risk-relevant conditions and possible effects. Its identity is distinct from a particular risk case, a scenario execution and the uncertain effects themselves.
concepts.rationale: The reusable pattern remains a documentary specialization. The comparison with intended steps is useful context, not a requirement that every pattern express an intention or be an execution plan.
concepts.context_interpretation: RX-002 links a continuing analytical case to its pattern; it does not identify the two. The inherited documentary identity and excluded blanket artifact set do not supply a Plan equivalence or register-approval condition.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected primary-passage comparison plus explicit source ancestry, changed-neighbor and set-policy review; no independent expert rating.

concepts.title: Risk Context Specification
concepts.authored_definition: A versioned information specification of analysis boundaries, circumstances, time horizon and objective references under which risk statements and results are interpreted.
concepts.rationale: The context specification retains boundaries, horizon and objective references. Generic entity context does not supply that schema or its version policy.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-35/RX-001 now refer to the explicitly analytical RiskCase. Missing task inputs concern readiness under a declared profile, not nonexistence or formal admission of that case.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected primary-passage comparison plus explicit source ancestry, changed-neighbor and set-policy review; no independent expert rating.

concepts.title: Risk Scenario Specification
concepts.authored_definition: A managed information specification of a possible development of conditions, events and effects concerning one or more RiskCases. Several scenarios may concern one case; a scenario is not the case or an actual occurrence.
concepts.rationale: Retain a bounded analogy to the security scenario entry. Riskium describes possible developments about continuing cases, with a broader stated risk scope.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-36 separates a scenario from its analytical case and R-25 does not turn a specification into an actual occurrence. Inherited artifact identity remains documentary, without blanket sibling exclusion.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected primary-passage comparison plus explicit source ancestry, changed-neighbor and set-policy review; no independent expert rating.

concepts.title: Risk Occurrence
concepts.authored_definition: An actual occurrence or change relevant to a risk scenario; a scenario or report alone does not establish that it happened.
concepts.rationale: Retain the actuality boundary. Riskium requires an actual occurrence supported in context; a source entry permitting a potential event does not establish realization.
concepts.boundary: A scenario alone is not evidence that its occurrence happened.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Risk Nature Assertion
concepts.authored_definition: A source-qualified information assertion that possible or reported effects are favorable, unfavorable or mixed relative to identified objectives and context.
concepts.rationale: Retain contextual classification as a related use. The compared classifying term is a motivation instance, not the class of RiskNatureAssertion or proof of favorable/unfavorable meaning.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-41/R-42/R-43 keep the claim about a case, selected nature value and context separate. The analytical case reading leaves nature objective-relative; the claim does not establish truth by classification.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected primary-passage comparison plus explicit source ancestry, changed-neighbor and set-policy review; no independent expert rating.

concepts.title: Nature Term
concepts.authored_definition: A controlled value used to qualify the nature of effects relative to objectives; it does not classify risk independently of context. This is a managed vocabulary resource with scheme-qualified identity, not a bare string.
concepts.rationale: Retain the resource/label distinction. A NatureTerm is a controlled scheme-qualified vocabulary resource, whose wording alone does not determine its identity.
concepts.context_interpretation: The path through ClassificationTerm and VocabularyConcept preserves InformationArtifact identity. The retained GS-RKM-C019/GS-RKM-C017 groups are non-disjoint and incomplete; their source labels remain carried, not independently validated here.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected primary-passage comparison plus explicit source ancestry, changed-neighbor and set-policy review; no independent expert rating.

concepts.title: Risk Source
concepts.authored_definition: A contextual source role that an entity may play in giving rise to risk, alone or with other contributors. The catalog boundary spans possible bearer categories and is not assigned a single OntoUML stereotype here.
concepts.rationale: Retain a bounded analogy. Riskium allows heterogeneous contextual contributors and opportunity perspectives; the security-specific source does not supply that whole cross-category profile.
concepts.boundary: Do not assign one universal stereotype or a formal subsumption from a matching label.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Predisposing Condition
concepts.authored_definition: A risk-relevant situation that increases susceptibility to specified occurrences or effects. Reference to it requires explicit source support and does not establish a causal mechanism.
concepts.rationale: Retain the comparison with an explicit direction boundary. The authored Riskium situation increases susceptibility, whereas the inspected source allows likelihood changes in either direction.
concepts.boundary: The comparison does not establish a causal mechanism or justify silently broadening the authored definition.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Trigger
concepts.authored_definition: An actual occurrence interpreted as initiating a risk-relevant development in a specified context. A hypothetical trigger description is represented as scenario content, not as an actual Trigger individual.
concepts.rationale: Retain the actuality and initiation boundary. A Riskium Trigger is actual and initiating in its context; the compared potential-event entry alone supplies neither commitment.
concepts.boundary: A hypothetical trigger remains scenario content.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Consequence
concepts.authored_definition: An outcome relevant to objectives, considered as a referent distinct from a statement about it. Outcomes can have different ontological categories; no universal event or object stereotype is asserted.
concepts.rationale: Replace the scoped absence label with a positive comparison boundary: Riskium Consequence is an objective-relevant outcome referent, distinct from the compared potential event. No universal absence claim is made.
concepts.boundary: An outcome must not be identified with an event description merely because both occur in a source record.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Vulnerability
concepts.authored_definition: An intrinsic susceptibility of a bearer to specified risk-relevant conditions or effects. The proposed mode interpretation requires a supported bearer; security-specific exploitation meanings remain source-qualified.
concepts.rationale: Retain the security comparison and identify Mode separately as a modeling foundation. The current intrinsic-susceptibility interpretation requires a supported bearer; exactly-one characterization is distinct from a documentary weakness report.
concepts.boundary: Neither shared terminology nor the type annotation supplies actual bearer evidence or independent semantic acceptance.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Exposure
concepts.authored_definition: A time-qualified situation relating an affected bearer to a risk source or relevant condition. An exposure score or its description is information about that situation.
concepts.rationale: Retain the bounded exposure analogy. The authored Riskium referent is a time-qualified bearer/source situation; the inspected security discussion does not itself define that formal situation model.
concepts.boundary: An exposure value is information about the situation, not the situation itself.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Risk State
concepts.authored_definition: A temporally qualified state of a risk-relevant situation, distinct from the workflow status of its record.
concepts.rationale: Replace the scoped absence label with a contrast. Riskium explicitly individuates a temporally qualified risk situation; generic entity description does not supply its state identity or a workflow interpretation.
concepts.boundary: A record workflow status must not be substituted for the state of the risk-relevant situation.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Information Artifact
concepts.authored_definition: A managed documentary object with an instituted identity that persists across its descriptions and issued versions. Artifact identity is distinct from a file path, a storage row and semantic content.
concepts.rationale: Retain the documentary comparison. Riskium adds continuity across descriptions and issued versions; the revised typing rationale separates documentary institution from RiskCase approval. No universal admission rule follows.

illustrations.positive: One managed risk policy survives replacement of its file and issue of a new version.
illustrations.counterexample: A copied file path or storage row alone does not establish a second artifact identity.

concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported inspection of selected primary-source passages and the current authored model; no independent human rating.

concepts.title: Artifact Version
concepts.authored_definition: An identifiable issued documentary version of a managed information artifact. Its issued semantic content and effective dependency versions are immutable; revisions receive distinct version identities.
concepts.rationale: Retain the distinction: the issued version is the documentary object; Revision qualifies a derivation. First issue need not revise a predecessor. Issuance policy does not determine whether a RiskCase exists.

illustrations.positive: A correction is issued as a separately identified version with explicit predecessor lineage.
illustrations.counterexample: A revision relationship must not be substituted for the resulting version object.

concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported inspection of selected primary-source passages and the current authored model; no independent human rating.

concepts.title: Information Content
concepts.authored_definition: The abstract informational meaning expressed by artifacts or versions. Content identity requires an explicit equivalence policy and is not inferred from equal strings or file hashes.
concepts.rationale: Retain conceptual-entity context without importing a content identity policy. Riskium keeps abstract meaning separate from artifacts and versions and requires its own explicit equivalence criteria.
concepts.boundary: Equal strings or file digests alone do not establish content identity.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Vocabulary Concept
concepts.authored_definition: A managed terminological information artifact that identifies a vocabulary meaning independently of its labels. It is a vocabulary resource, not automatically a domain universal or the real-world entity denoted.
concepts.rationale: Retain vocabulary-concept and lexical-label context. A Riskium vocabulary resource is not automatically its referent or an OWL domain universal; the source also permits dual typing, so no global disjointness is inferred.
concepts.context_interpretation: G2-052 preserves documentary identity and the explicit GS-RKM-C017 policy does not make its listed subtypes exhaustive. Excluding the blanket artifact set leaves these subtype edges intact.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected primary-passage comparison plus explicit source ancestry, changed-neighbor and set-policy review; no independent expert rating.

concepts.title: Classification Scheme
concepts.authored_definition: A governed organization of classification concepts with an identified scope and version policy.
concepts.rationale: Retain the concept-scheme comparison without asserting identical extension. Scope, governance and version policy are additional Riskium commitments.
concepts.context_interpretation: GX-049 preserves artifact identity. R-05 records term membership under this profile; it is not a claim that the external scheme is closed or that the listed terms exhaust every possible member.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected primary-passage comparison plus explicit source ancestry, changed-neighbor and set-policy review; no independent expert rating.

concepts.title: Classification Term
concepts.authored_definition: A managed vocabulary item expressing a controlled classification value within an identified scheme. Scheme membership and version context constrain its interpretation. This is a managed vocabulary resource with scheme-qualified identity, not a bare string.
concepts.rationale: Retain the controlled-resource/label distinction. The selected scheme and version context qualify a classification value; lexical equality is not a universal or resource identity rule.
concepts.context_interpretation: G2-053/G2-052 preserve the inherited documentary identity. GS-RKM-C019 and GS-RKM-C017 remain explicitly non-disjoint and incomplete; no new covering, exclusivity or semantic-module claim is added.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected primary-passage comparison plus explicit source ancestry, changed-neighbor and set-policy review; no independent expert rating.

concepts.title: Classification Assertion
concepts.authored_definition: A source-qualified assignment of a classification term to a subject in a specified context.
concepts.rationale: Retain the distinction between a classification statement and its target. Annotation and classifying motivation inform this comparison without supplying Riskium source/context qualification or a formal class alignment.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-03 can classify an analytically identified RiskCase before organizational register admission. R-04/R-29 keep the selected term and documenting entry separate from the case and assertion.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected primary-passage comparison plus explicit source ancestry, changed-neighbor and set-policy review; no independent expert rating.

concepts.title: Tag
concepts.authored_definition: A managed annotation artifact carrying a lightweight label. Identical lexical labels do not by themselves identify one tag assignment or imply a formal taxonomy.
concepts.rationale: Retain tagging motivation and lexical-label context. The motivation instance is distinct from a Riskium tag artifact; identical words do not identify an assignment or imply a formal taxonomy.
concepts.context_interpretation: G2-054 preserves artifact identity and R-24 links the tag to an entry revision. Excluding blanket artifact sibling grouping neither merges tags with classification terms nor makes all document types exclusive.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected primary-passage comparison plus explicit source ancestry, changed-neighbor and set-policy review; no independent expert rating.

concepts.title: Risk Register Entry
concepts.authored_definition: A managed register record about exactly one RiskCase in this profile. Distinct entries, source systems or registers can record the same case. A software record is an implementation record, not an additional risk subject.
concepts.rationale: Retain generic documentary-entity context without importing case identity or cardinality rules. A register entry is a record about the analytical risk item, not another risk subject.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-01 targets one RiskCase in this profile and permits zero or many entries per case. R-33 relates distinct entry revisions to their entry; RX-008 assigns register membership. Neither an entry identifier nor organizational admission is the case's universal existence condition.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison and current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy plus selected registration/workflow source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Entry Revision
concepts.authored_definition: An identifiable version of a register entry, preserving the content and qualified links effective at its issue.
concepts.rationale: Retain the object/derivation distinction. Riskium EntryRevision is a version object with effective links; a qualified revision describes derivation rather than being that version or its creation activity.
concepts.boundary: Do not substitute a derivation qualification for an entry-version individual.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Risk Description
concepts.authored_definition: A descriptive information item about a risk case, pattern or scenario with an explicit description role and source.
concepts.rationale: Retain describing motivation as related documentary-function context. The source term is a motivation instance, not a class equivalent to RiskDescription or its risk referent.
concepts.context_interpretation: RK2-007/RK2-008/R-37 preserve case, pattern and scenario targets; R-39 qualifies description function. C-09 requires a published description target under its profile. Source/description context does not establish an actual occurrence or turn the description into its case.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison and current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy plus selected registration/workflow source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Consequence Statement
concepts.authored_definition: An information item expressing a possible or reported consequence; it is not the consequence itself.
concepts.rationale: Retain descriptive-function context while separating a possible/reported consequence statement from an outcome. The motivation does not supply consequence semantics or establish realization.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-22 concerns the analytical RiskCase; R-40 retains a source slot and RX-010 permits no actual-outcome referent (0..1). A recorded possible consequence must not be promoted into an observed outcome merely to populate a field.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison and current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy plus selected registration/workflow source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Identification Information
concepts.authored_definition: Recorded information about identifying a risk, including the stated source, channel, agent and available time information.
concepts.rationale: Retain attribution as a partial provenance comparison. Attribution of an identification document does not define the complete source/channel/participant/time record or mean that an agent created the RiskCase.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-07 identifies the analytical risk item, R-08 records actor references and R-27 records intake channels. R-52 connects the information to revisions. Documentary attribution is kept separate from actual risk causation, operational admission and available temporal precision.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison and current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy plus selected registration/workflow source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Intake Channel Term
concepts.authored_definition: A controlled value naming how risk information entered the registration process; it is not a risk source. This is a managed vocabulary resource with scheme-qualified identity, not a bare string.
concepts.rationale: Retain vocabulary-concept context for an intake-channel value. The channel describes how information arrived; it is not a real-world contributor to risk or a universal channel taxonomy.
concepts.context_interpretation: The path through ClassificationTerm and VocabularyConcept preserves InformationArtifact identity. R-27 records a source-qualified channel; common text neither identifies the vocabulary resource nor resolves a risk source.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison and current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy plus selected registration/workflow source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Description Role Term
concepts.authored_definition: A controlled value specifying the function of a description, such as title, summary or scenario description. This is a managed vocabulary resource with scheme-qualified identity, not a bare string.
concepts.rationale: Retain controlled vocabulary context for description function. Selecting a term such as title or summary does not itself create a description, a scenario or the described risk subject.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-39 supplies the selected function of a RiskDescription. Scheme-qualified term identity is inherited through ClassificationTerm/VocabularyConcept; retained groups remain incomplete and non-disjoint without a new semantic approval.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison and current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy plus selected registration/workflow source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Consequence Slot Term
concepts.authored_definition: A controlled value preserving the source-defined position or role of a consequence statement. This is a managed vocabulary resource with scheme-qualified identity, not a bare string.
concepts.rationale: Retain vocabulary-concept context for the source-defined consequence position/function. A slot is not a universal outcome ordering, a severity value or an actual consequence.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-40 preserves the original statement's source slot. The inherited documentary identity does not equate identical strings across schemes or force a scalar selection when multiple assertions apply.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison and current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy plus selected registration/workflow source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Risk Register
concepts.authored_definition: A managed informational register that organizes risk-entry records for a stated organizational scope and purpose. Its documentary identity does not make it an OntoUML collective or physical aggregate.
concepts.rationale: Retain collection membership as related information-level context. Riskium adds register scope, purpose and documentary governance without equating the register with an OntoUML collective or physical aggregate.
concepts.context_interpretation: RX-008 organizes entry records, while entries and their revisions keep separate identities. Register membership does not establish one-to-one case identity or require every analytical RiskCase to be operationally admitted.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison and current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy plus selected registration/workflow source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Assessment Activity
concepts.authored_definition: An actual activity contributing to risk identification, analysis or evaluation. It may cover only part of a risk assessment; the complete standardized assessment process is outside the current process-modeling scope.
concepts.rationale: Retain the activity/process scope distinction. A Riskium AssessmentActivity may contribute only one actual part of identification, analysis or evaluation; it is not automatically the complete security assessment process.
concepts.boundary: A planned assessment is not an actual assessment activity.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Assessment Information
concepts.authored_definition: A managed information artifact documenting an assessment and its scope, basis, methods, time context, participants and results. It is distinct from performing that assessment.
concepts.rationale: Retain the NIST security-report comparison as a documentary precedent. It describes an output of assessment, not the assessment activity or a universal enterprise/ecosystem report template.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-11 targets the continuing RiskCase; R-12 records basis and R-13/R-17 allow dimensional and score outputs. RX-014 pins context version, while optional method links are completed under the selected analytical task. Revised RiskCase and ArtifactVersion neighbors were reviewed.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected assessment source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Assessment Basis
concepts.authored_definition: A specification of assumptions and control conditions under which an assessment result is interpreted.
concepts.rationale: Clarify the former scoped-absence label as a contrast in definitional scope: generic prov:Entity can describe provenance, but does not define risk-specific assumptions or control conditions. No disjointness, global absence or exact external equivalent is asserted.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-12 makes the basis explicit for the assessment information; RK2-022 may identify the control baseline assumed. The documentary specification does not establish that the controls exist or are effective, and different bases cannot be silently pooled.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected assessment source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Dimension Assessment Result
concepts.authored_definition: A result for one assessment dimension, qualified by its method, scale, basis and relevant temporal context.
concepts.rationale: Retain DQV measurement as a pattern analogy. DQV concerns dataset quality; Riskium records a risk-dimension result with its own interpretation dependencies. DQV types and domain restrictions are not imported.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-48 identifies one dimension; R-14/R-15 and RX-016 retain optional scale, selected level and scale-version information. C-13/C-18 require compatible interpretation for comparison. The revised ArtifactVersion neighbor does not turn the result itself into a version or a measured real-world quality.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected assessment source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Assessment Method Specification
concepts.authored_definition: A versioned specification of procedures and rules used to produce and interpret assessment results.
concepts.rationale: Retain the reusable procedure/execution distinction from SOSA. A risk assessment method specification adds risk-specific interpretation rules; no SOSA restriction or full method equivalence is adopted.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-46/R-50 relate information and scores to a method; R-49 and RK2-018 describe permitted scales/dimensions. The specification retains documentary identity; a separately pinned ArtifactVersion identifies which issued content was used. A procedure description alone is not execution evidence.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected assessment source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Assessment Scale
concepts.authored_definition: A governed scale specification defining permissible values or ordered levels for a specified assessment dimension.
concepts.rationale: Retain NIST Table F-2 as an example of an interpreted severity scale. Its security-specific levels and numerical codes are not universal Riskium scales or probabilities and are not adopted as a mandatory scheme.
concepts.context_interpretation: RK2-019 declares one dimension, R-16 relates level resources to their scale, and version references qualify interpretation. Equal codes or labels across scales do not license ranking or arithmetic; qualitative values remain possible.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected assessment source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Risk Score Result
concepts.authored_definition: A numeric assessment output produced under a declared scoring method; it is not the risk itself or a universal definition of risk level.
concepts.rationale: Retain metric-qualified output as a DQV pattern analogy without equating dataset quality with risk. A recorded numeric output is neither the RiskCase nor an acceptability decision.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-50 requires a score method; R-18 permits zero or many component links for reported scores. C-21 separately requires declared components, a pinned method and adequate inputs for a computed score. C-18 preserves missing data as missing and does not certify a reported number as reproducible.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected assessment source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Assessment Scale Level
concepts.authored_definition: A managed vocabulary resource specifying a permissible value or category on an identified assessment scale version. It denotes a level; it is not a measured value occurrence or a bare lexical label.
concepts.rationale: Retain the SKOS distinction between an identified vocabulary resource and its lexical label. A level resource is not a value occurrence; this does not prohibit SKOS dual typing in general or adopt an OWL alignment.
concepts.context_interpretation: The VocabularyConcept ancestry preserves documentary identity; R-16 assigns one scale and R-15 selects a level for a result. C-13 also requires the selected level to match the scale version and dimension; a matching label alone is insufficient.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected assessment source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Assessment Dimension
concepts.authored_definition: A managed vocabulary resource specifying an assessment aspect, such as likelihood or consequence severity. The vocabulary item, the aspect denoted and its measured or judged value remain distinct.
concepts.rationale: Retain the DQV dimension/metric separation as a pattern analogy within its dataset-quality scope. Riskium uses a managed term for a risk-assessment aspect, distinct from the aspect denoted and the judged result.
concepts.context_interpretation: The path through ClassificationTerm/VocabularyConcept preserves scheme-qualified identity. R-48, RK2-018 and RK2-019 connect result, method and scale to the dimension. DQV metric requirements are not automatically added to the Riskium profile.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected assessment source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Epistemic Status Term
concepts.authored_definition: A controlled value indicating the evidential or epistemic character of a result, such as observed, estimated or projected. This is a managed vocabulary resource with scheme-qualified identity, not a bare string.
concepts.rationale: Retain SKOS vocabulary context for an observed, estimated or projected designation. SKOS does not establish that the designation is epistemically justified or that an estimate was observed.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-47 can qualify assessment information with a controlled status. Missing designation remains missing; the status resource, its text and the evidence supporting that status are separate. Retained incomplete/non-disjoint term groups are not newly approved as semantic partitions.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected assessment source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Treatment Decision Information
concepts.authored_definition: A recorded decision about treating risk, including the selected option, rationale, responsible authority and relevant basis.
concepts.rationale: Retain the contrast between a recorded choice and a response process. The NIST glossary entry is security-specific and attributed there to SP 800-39; it does not establish that a Riskium decision was authorized, executed or successful.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-19 relates the decision to the continuing RiskCase; R-20 selects a strategy. R-63 and RK2-014/RK2-015 may connect plans, evaluation and remaining-risk assessment. Those documentary links do not alone establish treatment execution or effectiveness.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected treatment/policy contracts; normative deferrals explicit; not independent expert or operational evaluation.

concepts.title: Treatment Strategy Term
concepts.authored_definition: A controlled value identifying a treatment approach; its selection is represented by a treatment decision. This is a managed vocabulary resource with scheme-qualified identity, not a bare string.
concepts.rationale: Retain SKOS vocabulary context for a scheme-qualified treatment approach. A selected strategy resource is distinct from a decision or action; no universal security-only list or formal SKOS equivalence is adopted.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-20 selects this term in decision information. ClassificationTerm/VocabularyConcept ancestry preserves managed resource identity, while common labels and retained sibling groups do not create equivalence, exclusivity or realized response.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected treatment/policy contracts; normative deferrals explicit; not independent expert or operational evaluation.

concepts.title: Plan Specification
concepts.authored_definition: A versioned specification of intended actions, resources, responsibilities, timing and conditions for a stated purpose.
concepts.rationale: Retain PROV Plan as related intended-action content. Riskium records its own resources, responsibility, timing, purpose and versions without adopting a full PROV representation or treating the plan as its execution.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-21 concerns one or more analytical risk cases; R-62 gives the plan role. R-64 relates an actual TreatmentActivity separately, and R-63 can connect decisions. A plan can be recorded before any execution is established; issued-content changes follow new-version lineage.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected treatment/policy contracts; normative deferrals explicit; not independent expert or operational evaluation.

concepts.title: Treatment Activity
concepts.authored_definition: An actual performance of actions intended to modify or otherwise respond to risk, distinct from the plan describing them.
concepts.rationale: Retain the response analogy and separate actual treatment performance from its plan. Intended risk modification does not by itself establish observed effectiveness.
concepts.boundary: A documented plan alone does not establish an executed treatment.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Risk Control
concepts.authored_definition: A contextual measure intended to maintain or modify risk. A policy, device, practice or activity may serve as its bearer. Implementation and observed effectiveness are separate claims; one cross-category stereotype is not asserted.
concepts.rationale: Retain the security-control analogy as one contextual use of Riskium RiskControl. The authored profile permits different bearer categories and separates implementation from effectiveness.
concepts.boundary: A named or installed measure alone is not proof of effectiveness; no cross-category stereotype is forced.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Plan Role Term
concepts.authored_definition: A controlled value describing the role of a plan, such as primary response or contingency. This is a managed vocabulary resource with scheme-qualified identity, not a bare string.
concepts.rationale: Retain vocabulary-resource context for primary-response, contingency or other plan functions. SKOS does not define those local functions, and a PlanRoleTerm is not an OntoUML agent role or performance of a response.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-62 assigns the chosen function to a plan specification. Scheme-qualified identity is inherited through ClassificationTerm/VocabularyConcept; the retained incomplete/non-disjoint groups are carried policy, not a new semantic-partition approval.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected treatment/policy contracts; normative deferrals explicit; not independent expert or operational evaluation.

concepts.title: Agent
concepts.authored_definition: An entity capable of performing or being accountable for relevant actions, including persons and organizations within the declared profile.
concepts.rationale: Retain the provenance-agent comparison without equating capabilities, accountability or identity policies. The Riskium Agent category aggregates bearers rather than supplying a new identity principle.
concepts.context_interpretation: The explicit AgentKinds set distinguishes human Person from Organization and remains incomplete. Excluding GS-RKM-C047 prevents bearer-kind classification from competing with responsible/authorizing participation. Changed Person/Organization typing rationales are checked at the generalization endpoints.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected-source comparison, ancestry/neighbor/set-policy review and bounded static identity/dependency checks; no instance-level or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Person
concepts.authored_definition: A human individual who may participate in risk management activities or assignments.
concepts.rationale: Retain a human-agent comparison without adopting external identity or typing axioms. Riskium preserves the person identity owned by the external domain; participation and a responsibility mandate need separate evidence.

illustrations.positive: The same externally identified person participates in two analyses without being duplicated.
illustrations.counterexample: An owner name in an imported document alone does not establish authority or a grounded assignment.

concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported inspection of selected primary-source passages and the current authored model; no independent human rating.

concepts.title: Organization
concepts.authored_definition: An organized social entity capable of carrying responsibilities and authorizations in the model's scope.
concepts.rationale: Retain an institutional-agent comparison. Capacity to carry responsibilities is distinct from a demonstrated mandate. Organization identity does not require local register approval of every analytical RiskCase.

illustrations.positive: A supplier organization is referenced by its external identity in an ecosystem analysis.
illustrations.counterexample: An organization record alone does not establish a responsibility relator or actual authorization.

concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported inspection of selected primary-source passages and the current authored model; no independent human rating.

concepts.title: Actor Reference
concepts.authored_definition: A source-level identifier or description referring to an actor whose identity may be unresolved.
concepts.rationale: Retain the documentary-reference/agent contrast. An actor identifier or description may remain unresolved and is not itself an identified responsible or authorizing agent.
concepts.context_interpretation: G-05 inherits InformationArtifact identity; R-53 permits no resolved agent (0..1). The revised documentary rationale does not turn a name, an identifier or local register approval into evidence of an actual mandate.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected-source comparison, ancestry/neighbor/set-policy review and bounded static identity/dependency checks; no instance-level or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Responsibility Assignment Information
concepts.authored_definition: A recorded statement about an assignment of responsibility or authority, distinct from the relationship it asserts.
concepts.rationale: Retain the claim/relationship contrast. A recorded responsibility assignment can describe an unsupported claim; a provenance association does not supply the full Riskium mandate-grounding contract.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-55 links the statement to at most one actual mandate and allows none. R-09 concerns an analytical RiskCase; neither this statement nor missing approval determines that case's existence. A named owner alone does not establish responsibility, accountability and approval authority together.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected-source comparison, ancestry/neighbor/set-policy review and bounded static identity/dependency checks; no instance-level or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Responsibility Relator
concepts.authored_definition: A temporally qualified responsibility relationship connecting its participants, responsibility scope and grounding assignment.
concepts.rationale: Retain Relator as a modeling foundation rather than an external responsibility definition. Riskium adds grounding, temporal scope and responsibility semantics; its distinct-participant identity rule is additional to the C2 minimum-cardinality sum.
concepts.boundary: An owner name alone does not establish a grounded mandate or distinct mediated participants; independent judgment remains #23.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Responsible Agent Role
concepts.authored_definition: A context-dependent role borne by an agent with an assigned responsibility.
concepts.rationale: Retain an analogy to provenance role/association descriptions. ResponsibleAgentRole is a contextual bearer classification, not a PROV Role function description or the statement recording an assignment.
concepts.context_interpretation: The abstract roleMixin inherits no single sortal identity; its person and organization specializations retain their different identities. R-56 supplies a mandatory inherited mediation dependency. This source structure does not prove that a particular mandate actually exists.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected-source comparison, ancestry/neighbor/set-policy review and bounded static identity/dependency checks; no instance-level or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Authorizing Agent Role
concepts.authored_definition: A context-dependent role borne by an agent authorized to approve or issue a specified decision or assignment.
concepts.rationale: Retain the bounded analogy. An authorizing role requires a supported authority context; a provenance function or activity participation alone does not establish approval authority.
concepts.context_interpretation: The abstract roleMixin aggregates person and organization bearers without supplying identity. R-57 supplies the selected mandatory dependency. Responsible and authorizing participation are not globally exclusive merely because they share Agent as a parent.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected-source comparison, ancestry/neighbor/set-policy review and bounded static identity/dependency checks; no instance-level or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Responsible Person
concepts.authored_definition: A person bearing a responsible-agent role in a specified assignment context.
concepts.rationale: Retain the person/function analogy while preserving the assigned responsible-person role as a contextual participation of the same human bearer.
concepts.context_interpretation: G-24 provides the sole inherited identity supplier Person; G-25 supplies the ResponsibleAgentRole path and inherited R-56 mediation. The same human can bear different roles across contexts without being duplicated or merged with an organization.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected-source comparison, ancestry/neighbor/set-policy review and bounded static identity/dependency checks; no instance-level or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Responsible Organization
concepts.authored_definition: An organization bearing a responsible-agent role in a specified assignment context.
concepts.rationale: Retain the organization/function analogy without substituting a vocabulary function for a supported responsible-organization participation.
concepts.context_interpretation: G-26 preserves the sole Organization identity and G-27 supplies the responsible-role path and inherited R-56 mediation. A corporate representative is not the organization; an organizational record alone is not evidence of a grounded mandate.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected-source comparison, ancestry/neighbor/set-policy review and bounded static identity/dependency checks; no instance-level or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Authorizing Person
concepts.authored_definition: A person bearing an authorizing-agent role in a specified context.
concepts.rationale: Retain the analogy while separating human identity from supported approval authority. A provenance role label supplies neither a mandate nor a decision-specific authorization policy.
concepts.context_interpretation: G-28 preserves Person identity, G-29 supplies the authorizing-role path and R-57 is inherited. The non-disjoint Person sibling policy permits different contextual roles without asserting that one person fills both distinct participants of one mandate.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected-source comparison, ancestry/neighbor/set-policy review and bounded static identity/dependency checks; no instance-level or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Authorizing Organization
concepts.authored_definition: An organization bearing an authorizing-agent role in a specified context.
concepts.rationale: Retain the organization/function analogy while treating approval authority as contextual and supported rather than entailed by an organizational name or class membership.
concepts.context_interpretation: G-30 preserves Organization identity; G-31 supplies the authorizing-role path and inherited R-57 dependency. Organizational bearer kinds remain distinct from human representatives, while responsible/authorizing participation is not made globally exclusive.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected-source comparison, ancestry/neighbor/set-policy review and bounded static identity/dependency checks; no instance-level or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Responsibility Role Term
concepts.authored_definition: A controlled value identifying the kind of responsibility or authority assigned. This is a managed vocabulary resource with scheme-qualified identity, not a bare string.
concepts.rationale: Retain vocabulary-concept/function context. The controlled term denotes a responsibility or authority kind; selecting the term does not instantiate the actual role or the mandate grounding it.
concepts.context_interpretation: The path through ClassificationTerm and VocabularyConcept preserves InformationArtifact identity. R-54 records an assignment's selected term and R-59 a mandate's term; lexical equality alone establishes neither mandate identity nor actual authorization.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected-source comparison, ancestry/neighbor/set-policy review and bounded static identity/dependency checks; no instance-level or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Analysis State Term
concepts.authored_definition: A controlled value describing progress of analysis under a specified analysis-state scheme. This is a managed vocabulary resource with scheme-qualified identity, not a bare string.
concepts.rationale: Retain vocabulary-concept context for analysis progress. A value under a declared analysis scheme is not the state of a real-world risk situation or evidence of assessment quality.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-31 optionally records analysis state in a RecordStateAssertion. Scheme/version and temporal qualification matter; incomplete or absent state information is not silently replaced by a workflow value or an invented completion result.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison and current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy plus selected registration/workflow source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Workflow State Term
concepts.authored_definition: A controlled value describing handling or processing status under a specified workflow scheme. This is a managed vocabulary resource with scheme-qualified identity, not a bare string.
concepts.rationale: Retain vocabulary-concept context for handling/processing status. A workflow label such as Closed does not establish risk cessation, successful treatment or actual authorization.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-32 records an optional workflow value; RX-029 and RX-030 link a workflow assignment to its value and scheme version. C-19 preserves unknown rules/authority as unknown. The term resource is not the assignment situation.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison and current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy plus selected registration/workflow source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Record State Assertion
concepts.authored_definition: A qualified statement about a record's state, preserving the source and available temporal precision.
concepts.rationale: Retain annotation as related statement/target context. Riskium additionally preserves record aboutness, source and available time precision; no Annotation serialization contract or state-situation equivalence is adopted.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-23 attaches the statement to an EntryRevision, R-31/R-32 can retain separate analysis/workflow values, and RX-032 optionally documents a WorkflowAssignment. The statement remains documentary; the assignment remains a situation. Corrections and lineage follow C-03/C-24 without overwriting issued content.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison and current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy plus selected registration/workflow source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Workflow Scheme Version
concepts.authored_definition: An issued version of a scheme defining workflow values and permitted transitions.
concepts.rationale: Retain the comparison boundary. Riskium WorkflowSchemeVersion is an issued transition specification; concept-scheme aggregation or a revision qualification does not define its transitions or authorization rules.
concepts.boundary: Do not infer executable workflow rules from a concept aggregation or version lineage.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Workflow Assignment
concepts.authored_definition: A temporally bounded situation in which a managed record revision has an assigned workflow state under an identified scheme version; the statement documenting this situation is separate.
concepts.rationale: Replace the scoped absence label with a contrast. Riskium WorkflowAssignment is a timed record-state situation under a scheme version, rather than an activity-function description.
concepts.boundary: The statement documenting an assignment is distinct from the assignment situation.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Evidence Reference
concepts.authored_definition: A qualified reference linking a claim or activity to an evidence item, with its intended evidential role and provenance.
concepts.rationale: Retain derivation as one related provenance pattern, not as a definition of evidential use. Evidence may be used without deriving a new entity or endorsing a claim; a citation does not establish independent corroboration.
concepts.context_interpretation: The reference keeps documentary identity and ordinary RX-021 linkage. Its local-edge difference is the added GE-001 specialization from EvidenceReferenceRole, not an altered direct association. RE-001/RE-002 and C-26 separately describe grounded use and distinct participants. R-68 is read with C-12 and its no-proof rationale, preserving support/challenge/context distinctions.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected evidence/monitoring contracts; not a new engine, instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Evidence Item
concepts.authored_definition: An information artifact playing an evidential role for a specified claim or analytical activity. The same artifact may be used as evidence in one context and not another.
concepts.rationale: Retain the external comparison and separately document the role foundation. EvidenceItem inherits artifact identity; RE-001 makes participation depend on grounded use. It does not classify every artifact as evidence everywhere.

illustrations.positive: A retained report plays an evidential role in one grounded analysis and remains the same artifact afterwards.
illustrations.counterexample: A bibliography mention alone does not establish actual evidential participation or claim truth.

concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported inspection of selected primary-source passages and the current authored model; no independent human rating.

concepts.title: Observation Activity
concepts.authored_definition: An activity that observes a stated feature of a subject using a declared procedure and temporal context.
concepts.rationale: Retain the procedure/feature/value observation comparison. Riskium keeps its stated subject, procedure and temporal context without automatically importing every source restriction.
concepts.boundary: An observation report is information about an activity; the comparison does not establish all-profile equivalence.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported reinspection of selected primary passages and unchanged authored/local structural context; not an independent expert judgment.

concepts.title: Observation Result
concepts.authored_definition: An information result produced by an observation activity, qualified by subject, time, method and available units.
concepts.rationale: Retain SOSA Result as related output context. SOSA also covers actuation and sampling results, while this Riskium concept selects observation information qualified by subject, method, time and available units; no class equivalence or imported restriction is asserted.
concepts.context_interpretation: RX-022 relates an ObservationActivity to its informational result; RX-023 identifies the indicator and RX-024 the continuing RiskCase. RK2-026 can retain context and RK2-017 connects revisions. The result is neither its activity nor a risk occurrence; a numeric value alone is insufficient for cross-context comparison.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected evidence/monitoring contracts; not a new engine, instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Indicator
concepts.authored_definition: A versioned information specification of an observable or computed indicator, including its intended interpretation. A reported indicator value is an ObservationResult, not the specification.
concepts.rationale: Retain DQV Metric and SOSA ObservableProperty as bounded pattern comparisons. DQV concerns dataset quality; SOSA describes an observable feature quality. Riskium Indicator is an information specification, distinct from the property and its measured value.
concepts.context_interpretation: RX-023 links reported results to their indicator specification; RX-025 can anchor a threshold. Specification versions and interpretation remain documentary. Neither external property classes nor DQV domain constraints are automatically imported into Riskium.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected evidence/monitoring contracts; not a new engine, instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Threshold
concepts.authored_definition: A versioned information specification of a context-qualified decision boundary for an indicator or assessment scale, with a comparator, permissible value interpretation and applicability context.
concepts.rationale: Clarify the former scoped-absence label as a contrast in intended role: a DQV measuring standard does not itself specify a comparator-qualified decision boundary. No global absence, class disjointness or exact threshold equivalence is asserted.
concepts.context_interpretation: RX-025 and RK2-020 each permit an indicator or scale anchor. C-08 requires at least one supported anchor, with compatible interpretation if both exist; it does not require both. Qualitative boundaries retain scale semantics rather than invented numerical units. RX-027 records selected signal comparison.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected evidence/monitoring contracts; not a new engine, instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Signal
concepts.authored_definition: An information item indicating a potentially relevant change or condition and potentially prompting review; it does not by itself establish a risk event.
concepts.rationale: Retain the relationship to observation results without equating every signal with a SOSA Result or an actual risk event. A signal is information selected as potentially relevant to review; its significance requires context.
concepts.context_interpretation: RX-026 requires supporting observation results in the managed signal profile; RX-027 can identify thresholds and RX-028 can prompt case review. Revised RiskCase meaning was reviewed. Source incomplete material is retained without fabricating observations; neither an alert nor a crossed threshold automatically proves a risk occurrence or cause.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected evidence/monitoring contracts; not a new engine, instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Risk Criteria
concepts.authored_definition: A versioned information specification of reference conditions used to judge the significance or acceptability of risk in an identified context.
concepts.rationale: Retain the explicit licensed-source deferral. The ISO catalogue reconfirms edition identity and generic vocabulary purpose only; no exact risk-criteria wording, clause locator or standards crosswalk is adopted from metadata.
concepts.context_interpretation: RX-017 qualifies the criteria specification by context. RX-018/RX-019 permit appetite/tolerance statements without making them universally mandatory or identical. The local C-25 version-target obligation remains separate from any uninspected normative definition.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected treatment/policy contracts; normative deferrals explicit; not independent expert or operational evaluation.

concepts.title: Risk Appetite Statement
concepts.authored_definition: A managed, versioned statement recording the kinds and extent of risk an organization is prepared to pursue or retain, qualified by source framework, objectives, authority and context.
concepts.rationale: Retain the explicit normative deferral to #78. The managed appetite statement and its source qualification remain Riskium-authored; no catalogue abstract is promoted into an ISO/Risk IT/COBIT term definition or proof of authority.
concepts.context_interpretation: RK2-023 requires context under this managed profile, and RX-018 can connect criteria to the statement. Its objective, authority and framework qualifications preserve provenance; a statement is not universal permission for every case or evidence that an organization acted on it.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected treatment/policy contracts; normative deferrals explicit; not independent expert or operational evaluation.

concepts.title: Risk Tolerance Statement
concepts.authored_definition: A managed, versioned statement recording an organization's stated risk tolerance under an explicitly identified source vocabulary or framework and context. Permissible deviation and readiness to bear remaining risk are retained as distinct source meanings, not silently merged.
concepts.rationale: Retain the explicit normative deferral and source-specific tolerance meanings. Permissible-deviation and remaining-risk readings are not silently equated or attributed to an unseen ISO clause; exact edition-qualified interpretation remains #78.
concepts.context_interpretation: RK2-024 requires context under the managed profile and RX-019 optionally connects criteria. C-10 preserves framework/version/original meaning; common tolerance labels do not justify pooling values or applying a threshold to an unrelated context.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected treatment/policy contracts; normative deferrals explicit; not independent expert or operational evaluation.

concepts.title: Evidence Use Relator
concepts.authored_definition: A context-qualified evidential-use relationship connecting a qualified reference and a distinct information artifact used as support, challenge or context in an analysis. Its grounding concerns that use, not the truth of the referenced claim.
concepts.rationale: Use an analogy to provenance usage while preserving the different participant structure. Riskium objectifies a grounded use linking a qualified reference and an evidence artifact, with context and purpose. RE-001 and RE-002 mediate the participants; RE-003 records grounding. OntoUML C2 supplies a minimum-count rule; distinct participants are an additional Riskium C-26 commitment, not a conclusion from that sum.

illustrations.positive: A documented analysis uses a particular report as support through a distinct qualified reference and a grounding record.
illustrations.counterexample: A proposed citation without grounded use is information; reusing one individual at both mediated ends violates Riskium C-26.

concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported inspection of selected primary-source passages and the current authored model; no independent human rating.

concepts.title: Evidence Reference Role
concepts.authored_definition: A qualified EvidenceReference participating in an actual grounded evidential-use relationship. The reference retains documentary identity when it is only a record of a proposed use.
concepts.rationale: Distinguish a function description from the documentary reference that participates in grounded use. GE-001 preserves reference identity through EvidenceReference and InformationArtifact; RE-002 supplies the role dependency. The reference can exist as a record of proposed use without this role membership.

illustrations.positive: An existing qualified reference participates in an actual grounded use while keeping its documentary identity.
illustrations.counterexample: Assigning a PROV function label or recording a proposed use alone does not instantiate this participation role.

concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported inspection of selected primary-source passages and the current authored model; no independent human rating.

concepts.title: Risk Case
concepts.authored_definition: An identifiable risk item for analysis and tracking in relation to objectives and context, which may represent a threat or opportunity from a specified perspective. Its identity persists across descriptions, assessments and administrative record states. It is distinct from a register entry, scenario specification and actual occurrence. Formal organizational register acceptance is application-specific, not a general condition for its existence.
concepts.rationale: Replace the old scoped absence label with an explicit comparison boundary. RiskCase is the continuing analytical item for objectives and context, including threat or opportunity perspectives. A generic Entity comparison does not supply its continuity rule. Register admission remains a local application policy. This disposition makes no novelty or universal absence claim.

illustrations.positive: One analytical risk item is tracked before register admission and later described by several entries.
illustrations.counterexample: Equal labels, equal scores or missing organizational approval do not by themselves decide case identity.

concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported inspection of selected primary-source passages and the current authored model; no independent human rating.

concepts.title: Objective Reference
concepts.authored_definition: A managed information item identifying an objective in its source context, without asserting that the information item is the objective.
concepts.rationale: Retain the distinction between an informational reference and the objective it identifies. Generic PROV Entity has broad provenance scope and does not alone determine referent identity or objective achievement.
concepts.context_interpretation: RX-003 connects analytical RiskCase to objective references; RK2-011 allows context-specific references. Revised RiskCase meaning was reviewed. The reference can identify source-context objectives without importing an entire organization ontology or asserting that the objective has been achieved.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected treatment/policy contracts; normative deferrals explicit; not independent expert or operational evaluation.

concepts.title: Uncertainty Statement
concepts.authored_definition: A managed statement of what is uncertain about a risk case, including assumptions and evidential limitations; it does not imply a numerical probability.
concepts.rationale: Retain the annotation body/target pattern for an uncertainty statement, without importing its serialization contract or treating the statement as a probability distribution.
concepts.context_interpretation: RX-004 concerns a continuing RiskCase; RK2-012/RK2-013 retain context and its use in assessment information. Revised RiskCase meaning was reviewed. Assumptions and evidential limitations may be qualitative; absence of a probability is not zero uncertainty.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected assessment source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Risk Evaluation Outcome
concepts.authored_definition: A recorded judgment of risk significance or acceptability based on identified assessment information and criteria versions. It is distinct from a numeric score and from the evaluation activity.
concepts.rationale: Retain the distinction between a criteria-based significance/acceptability judgment and a DQV metric result. This is a difference of intended role, not a global disjointness claim between external and local classes.
concepts.context_interpretation: RX-011 identifies the case, RX-012 requires assessment information and RX-013 pins a criteria ArtifactVersion. C-25 governs the versioned target. A numeric score alone does not establish acceptability or a treatment decision; revised case and version neighbors were reviewed.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported primary-passage comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected assessment source-contract checks; not an instance or independent expert evaluation.

concepts.title: Control Reference
concepts.authored_definition: A managed identifier or description of a claimed control whose real-world bearer may remain unresolved.
concepts.rationale: Retain the contrast between a managed control identifier/description and a safeguard. NIST security-controls text retains its FIPS 199/CNSSI 4009 attribution; neither it nor PROV Entity proves a resolved bearer, implementation or effectiveness.
concepts.context_interpretation: RX-020 keeps resolution to the heterogeneous control boundary optional. RK2-016/RK2-022 retain register and assessment-baseline references. C-14 excludes a uniform formal-core RiskControl class, so unresolved references remain information rather than fabricated realized controls.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported source comparison, current ancestry/neighbor/set-policy and selected treatment/policy contracts; normative deferrals explicit; not independent expert or operational evaluation.

concepts.title: Risk Source Reference
concepts.authored_definition: A managed information artifact identifying or describing a claimed contributor to risk in a declared context. The referenced contributor may be unresolved, hypothetical or heterogeneous. The reference does not establish actual causation or an actual occurrence.
concepts.rationale: Retain the document/referent contrast. A managed contributor reference may describe an unresolved or hypothetical contributor; it is not that contributor or evidence of actual causation.
concepts.context_interpretation: G3-001 supplies documentary identity. RK3-001 concerns an analytical RiskCase; RK3-002 is the distinct source-resolution link and RK3-003 supplies context. No universal bearer category or operational-admission requirement is introduced.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected primary-passage comparison plus explicit source ancestry, changed-neighbor and set-policy review; no independent expert rating.
